description: Verifies the rendered shadow of a Schwarzschild black hole seen from r = 50 M: the angular radius of the shadow edge found along the central row of a 128 by 128 frame agrees with the analytic critical angle asin(3 sqrt(3) M sqrt(1 - 2M/r) / r) within 5 percent.

checks.label: a celestial pixel exists to the right of the shadow centre
